Done. The plan at `out/T3/plan.yaml` ran successfully on the first attempt and the self-report is written.

What the plan does:
- Asserts the input has 114 tensors and that the projection pattern matches 112 names.
- Casts those 112 matrices to bfloat16 in place with `cast_`, using one regex covering q/k/v/o and gate/up/down projections.
- Asserts the projection pattern is bfloat16, its negative-lookahead complement is float32, the layer-0 q_proj is bfloat16, the embedding is float32, and the total is still 114.
- Writes sharded safetensors to `out/T3/` with a 256MB shard budget.

Output layout:

| Item | Result |
|---|---|
| Shards | 10 files |
| Embedding shards | shards 1 and 2, 412 MB each, one tensor each |
| Remaining shards | 8 files, each just under the 256 MiB budget |
| Index weight_map entries | 114 |

One note: the "exactly 112 bfloat16" check cannot be expressed as a dtype-based count, so it is implemented as a name-pattern count plus dtype assertions on the pattern and its complement, which together are equivalent. The report at `out/T3/REPORT.md` records this.
